shots.prompt: He sits still in the dark car, hands on the wheel; his jaw tightens, he swallows hard. Streetlight flickers. Slow push-in. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
He slowly lowers his forehead onto the steering wheel; his shoulders begin to shake silently as a tear falls. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.

The camera slowly moves in; his body gradually becomes translucent like glass, revealing a softly glowing skeleton, heart and brain inside. Magical, smooth. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
Glowing red particles stream out above the kidneys and spread through the blood vessels across his body. The camera glides through the chest. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The glowing red heart beats fast; the neck and shoulder muscles tighten with pulses of red light. Close-up camera inside the chest. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
He lies awake in bed; lights keep flashing busily inside his brain while the room stays dark. Slow push-in. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The warm golden glow inside his body slowly fades and dims from the bottom up over time. Gentle slow camera orbit. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The camera flies into the translucent head; a glowing ring inside the brain slowly loosens and opens. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
A single glowing tear wells up and slowly rolls down his translucent cheek. Very close, slow. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
A calm blue wave of light travels from his brain down his spine and spreads through the body, turning the red glow into soft blue. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The glowing heart slows to a calm beat; the lungs fill with a deep, long breath and slowly release it. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The front door opens; his wife greets him with a gentle smile and he steps into the warm light. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
His wife gently places her hand on his shoulder; he smiles with tears in his eyes and nods. Warm, tender. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
